query:
SELECT d.id, d.gender, w.wealth_level 
FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
JOIN estishraf_llm_wealth_index w ON d.id = w.head_of_household_id
WHERE d.person_status = 'صالح' 
AND d.gender = 'F'
AND d.death_date IS NULL LIMIT 1200
